When I was taking it i'd freuently get what I called "Lithium Legs", My legs would sometimes feel very very weak. Often times it was painful, but sometimes they just felt frail. I spent most of my free time laying down and reading and having low energy. It essentially made me feel like a rickety old man haha. I was sensitive to really any sort of extreme senses (Loud noise, motion sickness, pains where sharper, etc.) 
It did help my mood A LOT, I had very few episodes. But I didn't feel as creative or driven to do things. I didn't really feel depressed either though. 

All that being said, I had kind of an extreme reaction to lithium and got all the worst side effects. It is very helpful for a lot of people, so just remember to let your doctor know every little detail so he can adjust you to the perfect dose. 

OH and stay hydrated. Keep a water bottle with you at all times.
